title: M&I/Partners has no build capability but publishes the hospital IT benchmark
content:
M&I/Partners is vendor-neutral by design and has no build capability, so the only route through it is influence. What makes it more than a generic advisory entry is that it publishes the hospital IT benchmark, and the record cites healthcare IT spend at 6.0% of revenue.

A published benchmark is a specific kind of leverage. It sets the figure hospital boards use to judge whether their own IT spend is reasonable, which means it shapes what counts as a normal investment before any vendor is in the room. Being read by the party that publishes that number is worth more than a referral from a firm holding no such instrument.

Because it cannot deliver anything, it does not compete for the application layer and it does not belong in the design-partner pool. It sits at priority 4 as an influence route.
